description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #6; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). Adds the Gemini 'Google app missing: open Gemini in browser' patch: recent Gemini builds host the chat inside the Google app (the shell deep-links https://bard.google.com/android?source=bardshell into GSA), so the 'Download or enable the Google app' dialog is removed by opening gemini.google.com/app in the browser instead. Pre-migration Gemini builds (1.0.776555963, 1.0.608774175) are registered as experimental targets for fully in-app, Google-app-free use with the MicroG integration patch. Carries re-cut #5 (Gemini MicroG integration), #4 (Gemini permission/privacy patches), #3 (Mereframe all-bridge sweep, #34/#35/#29) and #2 (Netflix Android TV).
